About.title: Welcome to an Ancient Tapobhoomi
About.description_1: Shridhyan Ashram is a sacred Himalayan sanctuary nestled in Mathali, Uttarkashi, dedicated to authentic meditation, inner silence, and yogic contemplation under the guidance of Param Pujya Swami Ji Maharaj.
About.description_2: Consecrated through decades of dedicated tapasya, the atmosphere remains saturated with natural serenity, untouched mountain air, and the timeless presence of the Guru lineage.

Philosophy.description: Here, nature is not merely a part of the ashram, but an integral part of the spiritual atmosphere.

Tapobhoomi.title: The Spiritual Heritage of an Ancient Tapobhoomi
Tapobhoomi.description: Situated in the pristine heights of Mathali, Uttarkashi, this consecrated land offers the ideal atmospheric stillness for deep meditation and authentic self-realization.

GuruParampara.title: Guru Parampara & Divine Grace
GuruParampara.description: In the sacred Guru-Shishya tradition, tapasya, discipline, and direct inner experience form the spiritual foundation. Guru-kripa is the eternal guiding light of this inner journey.

Silence.title: Here, Silence is a Sadhana
Silence.description: The pure mountain breeze, the stillness of Himalayan peaks, and unconditioned quietude gently guide the mind inward toward luminous stillness.

Courses.title: Courses & Training
Courses.subtitle: Authentic spiritual training and meditation programs
Courses.c1_desc: Specialized practices in traditional Vedic energy, subtle balance, and holistic wellness.
Courses.c2_desc: Comprehensive training in classical meditation techniques, yogic discipline, and teaching methodology.
Courses.c3_desc: Authentic sadhana, mantras, contemplation, and worship in the sacred Shri Vidya tradition.

SpiritualFamily.title: Your Spiritual Family
SpiritualFamily.description: Wherever you come from in the world, if your heart seeks truth, silence, and genuine spiritual practice, Shridhyan Ashram warmly welcomes you.
